targets.summary: Splitting `.mul_(3. / N)` into `.mul_(3.).div_(N)` makes the code worse because it adds an extra in-place tensor op; a better fix for the narrowing-conversion issue is needed.
targets.evidence: Before, the code had two in-place ops: `.mul_(3.)` followed by `.div_(N));` (line 4967). In the merged version these became one in-place op, `.mul_(three_over_n));`, with `auto three_over_n = c10::SymFloat(3.) / c10::SymFloat(N);` computed beforehand. Doing the arithmetic in SymFloat removes the extra tensor op the maintainer objected to and still avoids the narrowing conversion. It is equivalent to the original single `.mul_(3. / N)`.
